feedback_interpretation: Recent measurements weakened smooth global loading and broad functional-group corrections. The m177 and m202 outcomes favor local solvent-by-loading interactions, while the m106 and donor outcomes show that endpoint-specific tails can arise in closely related structures. I therefore retain matched response curves but add independent high-width tail repairs across several chemical families.
batch_rationale: The batch combines high-width tail repair with interpretable local response experiments. It spans donor-containing molecules, basic heteroaromatics, ether-carbonyl systems, nitro compounds, aldehydes, fused esters, and acceptor-rich carbonyls. Matched m177 and m202 conditions probe local amount interactions; m159, m193, m28, m194, m205, m206, m207, m116, and m98-related regions provide intermediate transition coverage. The remaining selections sample distinct predicted tail regions so the retrained model can improve V2 calibration across the Row-distribution rather than overfit one scaffold. The batch covers both PE and DCM, low and high solvent strength, and 50, 100, and 150-ul loading conditions.
